application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

chemistry.note: Stated: BEV1 Tesla Model Y SR LFP, BEV2 Model Y LR NCA. The voltage-ratio rule agrees but cannot tell NCA from NMC: BEV1: LFP (ratio 1.020); BEV2: NMC-class (ratio 1.143).

cells_liion.note: Released CAN signals give pack voltage only; pack topology is not stated.

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.note: No individual cell-voltage signals are released.

energy_mwh.source: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-06148-5, p. 3 and Table 3 (60.5 kWh BEV1, 78.8 kWh BEV2)
energy_mwh.note: Cross-check computed from the data: BEV1 60.9 kWh (median of 18 slow charges spanning at least 40 percent SOC, TotalChargeKWh counter per 100 percent SOC); BEV2 80.1 kWh (median of 13 slow charges spanning at least 40 percent SOC, TotalChargeKWh counter per 100 percent SOC).

span_unit_years.note: First to last session date per vehicle, from session file names. BEV1 files run to 2025-05-27, past the paper's end of 2025-02-18, after a three-month gap; with the paper's periods the span is 1.55 vehicle-years (source audit 2026-10-04).

obs_hours.note: Observation-hours are not used when calendar spans are measurable or no cadence is available.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://doi.org/10.48804/8KPDTW; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
sentinels_documented.note: Odometer3B6 = 4294967.295 (0xFFFFFFFF x 0.001) observed in 13,498 rows, not documented; masked by clean=True.
